title: Dispatch: Validate campaign position at the store boundary (attempt 3)
description:
Dispatch of eshyra-jhpt.3 (attempt 3) — one small, focused change before this work goes to PR.

Attempt 2 (c3db41c) is ACCEPTED. The consolidated projection test covers all eight required cases (effective-turn filtering, supersession, revocation, ordering, A1 association data, all three shipped ambiguities unresolved with interpretations, ruling-beside-source, rendered unresolved/resolved text, and pack-byte immutability), campaignPosition is now required on ContextAssemblyInput, ambiguity ordering is codepoint, and resolveCampaignPosition throws CampaignRuleError. Keep all of it.

WORKTREE / BRANCH
.worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.3.3 on branch eshyra-jhpt.3.3, cut from c3db41c on eshyra-jhpt.3.2. Work only inside that worktree.

FINDING — an unparseable campaign position is silently treated as "match everything".
Making campaignPosition required closed the omitted-position hole, but the value is still an unvalidated raw string handed straight to SQL. Canonical positions begin with `cp1~`, so any string sorting after that prefix satisfies `effective_position <= ?` for every row. Attempt 2 introduced exactly such a value in about ten existing assembleContext call sites: `campaignPosition: 'test-position'`.
Reproduced:
    rule effective_position : cp1~000000000999~s~t     (effective far in the future)
    bogus cutoff            : test-position
    effective_position <= cutoff  ->  true
So a malformed position resurrects the future-rule leak that eshyra-jhpt.2 attempt 3 was dispatched to eliminate — same defect, different door. It does not fire in those tests only because they contain no campaign rules; the moment eshyra-jhpt.4, .5 or .9 copies that sentinel into a test that does have rules, it silently passes with the wrong active set.

FIX, two parts:
1. Validate at the store boundary. In packages/core/src/campaign/campaignRuleStore.ts, have the position-taking queries (listActiveCampaignRulesAtPosition, listActiveRulingsForAmbiguitiesAtPosition, and createCampaignRuleReadSeam's bound position) parse the incoming string with parseCampaignPosition from campaignRules.js and reject a malformed value with CampaignRuleError. parseCampaignPosition already enforces the canonical round trip, so this is a call, not new parsing logic. Failing loudly is the requirement: a position that cannot be parsed must never be compared. Add a test asserting a malformed position throws rather than returning rows. (campaignRuleStore.ts came from eshyra-jhpt.2, which is merged, but it is part of the same unmerged PR — editing it here is correct.)
2. Replace every `campaignPosition: 'test-position'` sentinel with a real canonical position built through formatCampaignPosition, in whichever test files attempt 2 touched (contextAssembler.test.ts and the other assembleContext callers). A shared helper in each file is fine. After the store validates, these sentinels will fail anyway — the point is that the replacement is a genuine position, not a differently-shaped placeholder.

SCOPE
Only the above. Do not change the projection, the rendering, the required-position signature, the migration, or the position-before-savepoint ordering in orchestrator.ts. Do not add new features; this bead goes to PR after this attempt.

VERIFICATION
`npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root, BEFORE committing (it rewrites files).
